steps.title: Prepare Induction Media
steps.instruction: Combine DMEM/F12+ (with sodium pyruvate and GlutaMAX), anti‑anti, N2 supplement, and B27 supplement to make the Induction Media.

steps.title: Prepare Neuron Media
steps.instruction: Combine BrainPhys, BDNF, GDNF, cAMP, ascorbic acid, N2, B27, mouse laminin, sodium pyruvate, GlutaMAX, and anti‑anti to make the Neuron Media.

steps.title: Harvest iPSCs with Accutase
steps.instruction: Incubate each well with 1 mL Accutase at 37 °C for 5–10 min (do not exceed 20 min).

steps.title: Resuspend cells in DMEM
steps.instruction: Gently resuspend the detached iPSCs in the Accutase, transfer to a 50 mL Falcon tube and add room‑temperature DMEM at a minimum 1:3 (Accutase : DMEM) volumetric ratio.

steps.title: Centrifuge cell suspension
steps.instruction: Spin the suspension at 800 g for 5 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Resuspend in Stemflex + ROCK inhibitor
steps.instruction: Aspirate the supernatant, resuspend the pellet in 1 mL Stemflex containing ROCK inhibitor THX at 1:1000, count the cells, and dilute with Stemflex + THX to a final concentration of 1 × 10⁶ cells · mL⁻¹.

steps.title: Add NGN2‑Puro and rtTA viruses
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL of each virus (NGN2‑Puro and rtTA) per 10 × 10⁶ cells (i.e., 50 µL per 10 mL of suspension). Mix by inversion and gentle repeated pipetting with a large strip pipette.

steps.title: Plate cells on Matrigel
steps.instruction: Dispense 1.0–1.5 mL of the virus‑mixed suspension per well of a 6‑well plate pre‑coated with 1× Matrigel.

steps.title: Overnight incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the plated cells at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for a minimum of 12 h and a maximum of 36 h.

steps.title: DIV1 media change with doxycycline
steps.instruction: In the biosafety cabinet, aspirate the virus‑containing medium and add Induction Media supplemented with doxycycline at 1 µg mL⁻¹.

steps.title: DIV2 media change with doxycycline and puromycin
steps.instruction: Replace the medium with Induction Media containing doxycycline 1 µg mL⁻¹ and puromycin 2 µg mL⁻¹.

steps.title: DIV3 optional repeat if death
steps.instruction: If substantial cell death is observed, repeat the DIV2 media change (Induction Media with doxycycline 1 µg mL⁻¹ and puromycin 2 µg mL⁻¹).

steps.title: DIV4 start AraC and split
steps.instruction: Add AraC to a final concentration of 4 µM and continue puromycin 2 µg mL⁻¹ (continue until DIV6). On DIV4 (or no later than DIV6) split the cells onto plates coated with either 0.1 % PEI + 2× Matrigel or 4× Matrigel. Discontinue doxycycline at this point.

steps.title: DIV5 media change with puromycin and AraC
steps.instruction: Replace the medium with Neuron Media supplemented with puromycin 2 µg mL⁻¹ and AraC 4 µM.

steps.title: DIV6 media change with AraC only
steps.instruction: Replace the medium with Neuron Media containing AraC 4 µM (puromycin discontinued).

steps.title: DIV8 AraC withdrawal or reduction
steps.instruction: If desired, discontinue AraC by replacing the medium with Neuron Media lacking AraC. Optionally reduce AraC to 2 µM from DIV8 and maintain until DIV10 if continued treatment is needed.

steps.title: DIV10 maintain in Neuron Media
steps.instruction: From DIV10 onward, culture the cells in Neuron Media alone (no AraC, puromycin, or doxycycline).

steps.title: Routine half‑volume media changes
steps.instruction: Perform half‑volume media changes three times per week (or full‑volume changes twice per week) until the desired harvest time point.
